problemNumbers.title: When an employee leaves the company, their knowledge leaves with them.
problemNumbers.problemBody: Every employee who leaves takes undocumented knowledge with them: the exceptions, the rules of thumb, the reasons behind decisions. What stays behind is longer ramp-up, repeated mistakes, and questions nobody can answer any more.
